rows.note: This is the neutral, all-purpose rendering for a male romantic partner.

example.english: My boyfriend is coming to pick me up tonight.
example.jyutping: ngo5 naam4 pang4 jau5 gam1 maan5 lei4 zip3 ngo5

rows.note: Use this very casual, slangy rendering when a rougher colloquial tone is appropriate; 男朋友 is safer and more neutral.

example.english: My boyfriend forgot my birthday again.
example.traditional: 我條仔又唔記得我生日喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tiu4 zai2 jau6 m4 gei3 dak1 ngo5 saang1 jat6 laa3
